title: Where’s the restroom? In Busan, social media has the answer
caption:
Foreign visitors in Busan are bypassing locked doors by sharing restroom passwords on social media. Without a dedicated city guide, tourists are turning to apps and forums to find accessible toilets.

Source: Koreaherald - Where’s the restroom? In Busan, social media has the answer
